name: gdrive-client
description: Google Drive workspace on Cloudflare Workers with OAuth writes and service-account content reads

scripts.test:e2e:journey: npm run build && playwright test -c playwright.journey.config.ts
scripts.db:migrations:remote:staging: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote --env staging
scripts.deploy: npm run build && node scripts/release/strip-dev-vars.ts && wrangler deploy
scripts.deploy:staging: CLOUDFLARE_ENV=staging npm run build && node scripts/release/strip-dev-vars.ts && CLOUDFLARE_ENV=staging wrangler deploy
scripts.deploy:dry-run: npm run build && node scripts/release/strip-dev-vars.ts && wrangler deploy --dry-run --outdir .wrangler/dry-run

APP_MASTER_KEY.description: Base64-encoded 32 random bytes; master key for server-side secret envelopes.

SETUP_TOKEN.description: Base64-encoded 32 random bytes; one-time token that authorizes initial admin setup.
